title: Results portal down on results day
alert: results-api 502; database read replica lag 90s at 40x normal traffic
root cause: Every results page hit the database and replicas fell behind
failed fixes: Adding more results-api pods (increased database load)
fix: Served results from pre-generated static pages on the CDN behind a waiting room

title: Assignment uploads rejected
alert: assignments-api 413 Payload Too Large for PDF submissions; learner ananya.k@gmail.com
root cause: An API gateway change lowered the upload limit from 50 MB to 1 MB
fix: Restored the 50 MB upload limit in the gateway and extended the deadline

title: Class timetable shifted by hours
alert: Timetable shows classes 5.5 hours late for 2,300 learners
root cause: The timetable sync wrote UTC times into a field the app reads as IST
fix: Re-ran the sync with IST conversion and added a timezone test

title: Certificates not generating
alert: 2,300 course certificates stuck; worker log: font not found NotoSans
root cause: A base image upgrade removed the font package the PDF renderer needs
fix: Added the font package back, redeployed and re-queued the failed certificates

title: Gradebook not saving marks
alert: grades-db lock wait timeout; teachers unable to save marks after the Sunday mock test
root cause: A heavy analytics report ran on the primary grades database
fix: Killed the report and moved analytics to the read replica

title: Login OTPs delayed
alert: auth-service OTP delivery p95 4 minutes at exam start; learner phone 9900112233
root cause: A marketing notification blast used the same SMS route as login OTPs
fix: Moved OTPs to a dedicated transactional SMS route with email OTP as fallback

title: Fee payments stuck as pending
alert: fee-payments webhook signature verification failed; 50,000 payments pending
root cause: The payment gateway webhook secret was rotated but not updated in fee-payments
failed fixes: Asking learners to pay again (caused double charges)
fix: Updated the webhook secret, reconciled pending payments and refunded duplicates
